entities.name: Māori in the New Zealand Wars
entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: Māori tribes fought the New Zealand Wars (1845–1872) against British colonization. They invented trench warfare 50 years before WWI, designed ingenious pā (fortifications), and adapted musket tactics while maintaining traditional warrior culture.
